import json,time,hashlib,os
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from torch.nn import functional as F
from controlled_degree2.calibrate_pair_geometry import pair_geometry_loss

torch.set_num_threads(2);torch.manual_seed(20260926)
root=Path('work_dirs/channelwise_population_probe_20260915')
p=Path('work_dirs/channelwise_template_cache_20260915/template_cache.pt')
h=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert h=='c5be8c7fed98899685544f11e7622017830307d95102953b03700c4491d54075'
c=torch.load(p,map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)['fit']
x=c['source'].float().cuda();y=c['teacher'].float().cuda();ids=torch.arange(len(x),device='cuda')
identity=torch.eye(x.shape[1],device='cuda');a=identity.clone().requires_grad_();b=torch.zeros(x.shape[1],device='cuda',requires_grad=True)
opt=torch.optim.Adam([a,b],lr=1e-4); times=[];losses=[]
torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
for step in range(20):
 torch.cuda.synchronize();start=time.perf_counter()
 z=x@a.T+b
 geom,stats=pair_geometry_loss(z,y,x,ids,.2)
 loss=geom+.01*(1-F.cosine_similarity(z,y)).mean()+.001*((a-identity).square().sum()+b.square().sum())/x.shape[1]
 assert torch.isfinite(loss)
 opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True);loss.backward()
 torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_([a,b],1.,error_if_nonfinite=True);opt.step()
 assert torch.isfinite(a).all() and torch.isfinite(b).all()
 torch.cuda.synchronize();times.append(time.perf_counter()-start);losses.append(float(loss))
r={'job_id':os.environ.get('SLURM_JOB_ID'),'gpu':torch.cuda.get_device_name(),'steps':20,'templates':len(x),'cache_sha256':h,'seed':20260926,'threshold':.2,'all_finite':True,'peak_allocated_bytes':torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),'peak_reserved_bytes':torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),'step_seconds':times,'losses':losses,'steady_step_seconds':sum(times[5:])/15,'estimated_2000_update_seconds':sum(times[5:])/15*2000,'pairs':stats['pairs'],'tail_pairs':stats['tail_pairs'],'scope':'20-step resource probe only; no candidate or accuracy evaluation'}
(root/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
